**Step 1 — Scene:** Two central plates appear to make up the meal: stir-fried noodles with meat and vegetables, plus sliced potatoes in a reddish sauce. Water is excluded.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** The noodle plate looks approximately 26 cm across: area ≈ **531 cm²**. The potato plate looks approximately 24 cm across: area ≈ **452 cm²**.

**Steps 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume and weight:** Coverage estimates divide the visible food into components without counting the same area twice.

| Visible item | Plate coverage | Area | Average height | Gross volume | Bulk density | Weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Noodles with clinging oily sauce | 48% of left plate | 255 cm² | 1.8 cm | 459 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 367 g |
| Meat pieces | 8% of left plate | 42 cm² | 1.0 cm | 42 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 40 g |
| Vegetable strips | 4% of left plate | 21 cm² | 0.8 cm | 17 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 10 g |
| Sliced potatoes | 42% of right plate | 190 cm² | 1.8 cm | 342 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 222 g |
| Reddish sauce and vegetable bits | 10% of right plate | 45 cm² | 0.6 cm | 27 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 27 g |

Food coverage totals **60% of the left plate** and **52% of the right plate**. Oil coating the noodles and potatoes is included in their energy estimates rather than counted again separately.

**Step 7 — Energy:** Using cooked, as-plated values:
- Noodles: 367 g × 190 kcal/100 g ≈ **697 kcal**
- Meat: 40 g × 230 ≈ **92 kcal**
- Vegetables: 10 g × 40 ≈ **4 kcal**
- Potatoes, including cooking oil: 222 g × 130 ≈ **289 kcal**
- Reddish sauce: 27 g × 70 ≈ **19 kcal**

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **666 g and 1,100 kcal** is plausible for the substantial noodle mound and smaller potato portion. The main uncertainties are pile depth and oil content.
